final: WITH fee_groups AS (SELECT feecoin, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate, AVG((rebrate - feerate) * 1.0 / feerate) AS avg_rate_ratio FROM fees GROUP BY feecoin), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rebate) AS avg_rebate FROM fee_groups) SELECT AVG(f.avg_rebate), AVG(f.avg_rate_ratio), AVG(f.avg_rebate - o.avg_rebate) FROM fee_groups AS f CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.avg_rebate IS NOT NULL AND f.avg_rebate > o.avg_rebate
